There are **nine homework assignments**, each worth 20 points and about 45 minutes of work. Together they are worth 20% of your grade, and **the lowest is dropped**.

Policies --- what they are for, how they are marked, and why the key posts when it does --- are on the [homework policies page](policies/homework.qmd).

## Dates

| Set | Out | Due | Key Posts | Rehearses | Topic |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| **HW1** | Fri 1/29 | Fri 2/05 | Sat 2/06 | Quiz 1 | Probability and Monte Carlo |
| **HW2** | Mon 2/08 | Fri 2/12 | Sat 2/13 | Quiz 2 | Regression and the hinge |
| **HW3** | Wed 2/17 | Fri 2/19 | Sat 2/20 | Quiz 2 | Null models and both bootstraps |
| **HW4** | Mon 2/22 | Fri 2/26 | Sat 2/27 | Quiz 3 | Bootstrap limits and Bayes |
| **HW5** | Mon 3/01 | Fri 3/05 | Sat 3/06 | Quiz 4 | MCMC |
| **HW6** | Mon 3/08 | Fri 3/12 | Sat 3/13 | Quiz 4 | GLMs, maximum entropy, time series |
| **HW7** | Fri 3/19 | Fri 3/26 | Sat 3/27 | Quiz 5 | Extremes |
| **HW8** | Fri 4/09 | Fri 4/16 | Sat 4/17 | Quiz 6 | Cross-validation |
| **HW9** | Mon 4/19 | Fri 4/23 | Sat 4/24 | Quiz 6 | Information criteria and the contrast |

There is no homework during the weeks a mini project is due, or over spring break. All assignments are due at **9:00pm Eastern**.

## Structure

Each assignment has three problems --- a scenario, three standalone quiz-format questions, and a computational item --- and is worth 20 points. The full breakdown, and why a homework point is not the same size as a quiz point, is on the [homework policies page](policies/homework.qmd#structure).

## The Key Posts A Day After The Deadline

Late work is accepted up to 24 hours at full credit, and the solution key goes up when that window closes --- so that a late submission is not just a copy of the key.

This still puts the key in your hands well before the quiz it rehearses. The shortest gap all semester is two days, and most are six or more:

| Set | Key posts | Quiz | Days with the key |
|:--|:--|:--|--:|
| HW1 | Sat 2/06 | Mon 2/08 | 2 |
| HW2 | Sat 2/13 | Mon 2/22 | 9 |
| HW3 | Sat 2/20 | Mon 2/22 | 2 |
| HW4 | Sat 2/27 | Fri 3/05 | 6 |
| HW5 | Sat 3/06 | Fri 3/19 | 13 |
| HW6 | Sat 3/13 | Fri 3/19 | 6 |
| HW7 | Sat 3/27 | Fri 4/09 | 13 |
| HW8 | Sat 4/17 | Fri 4/30 | 13 |
| HW9 | Sat 4/24 | Fri 4/30 | 6 |

Written feedback on the marked questions may arrive after the quiz, and that is fine: the *forms* of question recur across all six quizzes, so feedback on how you stated a model in February is still useful in April.
